value.section_label: Why Tribo — Unified Group Travel Platform
value.cell1_desc: A complete B2B SaaS toolset paired with a consumer social travel marketplace — no stitching separate tools together.
value.cell2_desc: Interactive trip feed with dynamic demographic filters across categories for backpackers and adventure seekers.
value.cell3_desc: One-click applicant approval and screening workflow gives organizers complete control over who joins every trip.
value.cell4_desc: Auto-generate day-by-day itineraries, transparent budget splits, and smart packing checklists instantly.
value.cell5_desc: Live WebSocket group messaging and dynamic expense split-tracking combined with instant AI planning in one app.

accordion.section_label: Our services — Sky, Sea, Land, Seal
accordion.headline: Every journey, protected.
accordion.sky_desc: Charter by the flight. Your payment stays in escrow until you land.
accordion.sea_desc: Sail with verified captains. Funds are released only after your voyage.
accordion.land_desc: Private transfers and expeditions, confirmed before you pay in full.
accordion.seal_desc: Every transaction sealed in escrow until delivery is confirmed.
